name: inspira-morphing-text
title: Morphing Text
blurb: Text smoothly morphs from one word to another in a loop.
description: Uses SVG or canvas morphing to transition letters between words in a wordlist, creating a fluid morphing effect. Loops indefinitely.
use_when: Tagline or hero heading showcasing multiple related concepts or features.
avoid_when: Body text or time-critical information — morphing delays readability.
a11y: Only the current morph frame is readable; no pause control or transcript.
